WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS site_avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_faces) AS status_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), selected AS (
  SELECT sa.site_avg_faces, sta.status_avg_faces, oa.overall_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.site_avg_faces > sta.status_avg_faces
    AND oa.overall_avg_faces IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) AS avg_face_count,
       AVG(site_avg_faces - overall_avg_faces) AS avg_above_overall,
       AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg_faces) AS avg_above_status
FROM selected;
